# Luviji Winery & Restaurant -- Hvar, Croatia

> Family-owned winery and rooftop restaurant in the heart of Hvar town. Five generations of winemaking tradition, six brands of quality wines from indigenous Hvar grape varieties, and a tasting room in the old family house at Jurja Novaka 6/1. Award-winning Pošip (BIWC 2024 Gold + Best of Show Croatia) and Divjok (BIWC 2024 Silver). Rated 4.9/5 on TripAdvisor.

## Quick Facts
- **Name**: Luviji (also known as Luviji Wine Tasting Room, Konoba Luviji Rooftop)
- **Type**: Family Winery + Rooftop Restaurant + Wine Tasting Room
- **Address**: Jurja Novaka 6/1, 21450 Hvar, Croatia
- **Coordinates**: 43.1729 N, 16.4411 E
- **Phone**: +385 91 519 8444
- **Email**: luviji.hvar@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://vinarija-xi.vercel.app
- **Online Reservations**: https://bookmeatable.com/restaurants/konoba-luviji-rooftop-135
- **Working Hours**: Daily 18:00 - 23:00
- **TripAdvisor Ranking**: #7 of 19 Food & Drink in Hvar
- **Rating**: 4.9/5 (TripAdvisor, 10 reviews)
- **Generations**: 5 (current operators include grandson Vjeko, host Hrvoje)
- **History**: Hvar island has 2,400 years of winemaking history dating back to ancient Greeks

## Wines (6 brands)
1. **Pošip** (white) -- Indigenous Dalmatian white grape. **BIWC 2024 Gold Medal + Best of Show Croatia (Luviji flagship).** Golden yellow, ripe peach, white flowers, Mediterranean herbs, mineral.
2. **Divjok** (red) -- Plavac Mali based, name means "wild one" in Hvar dialect. **BIWC 2024 Silver Medal.** Powerful, complex, forest fruit and Mediterranean herb notes.
3. **Plavac Mali** (red) -- Indigenous Dalmatian red grape, full-bodied, ripe cherry, plum, black pepper, soft tannins, aged in oak.
4. **Bogdanuša** (white) -- Indigenous Hvar variety known since ancient times. Light, fresh, lemon, green apple, white flowers.
5. **RosEtta** (rosé) -- From Plavac Mali. Pink, strawberry, raspberry, rose petals, refreshing.
6. **Prošek** (dessert white) -- Traditional Dalmatian dessert wine from sun-dried grapes. Amber, dried fruit, honey, fig, nuts. Sweet finish.

## Wine Tasting Packages
All tastings include homemade platter with cheese, cured meats, olive oil and bread.
- **4 wines + platter**: from €25 per person
- **5 wines + platter**: from €30 per person
- **6 wines + platter (with Prosek dessert wine)**: from €35 per person

Private group tastings available on request.

## Restaurant
- **Type**: Rooftop restaurant in Hvar town center
- **Cuisine**: Traditional Hvar and Dalmatian, Mediterranean
- **Specialties**: Gregada (Hvar fish stew), octopus under the bell (peka), grilled fresh fish, homemade pasta, pasticada with gnocchi
- **Wine pairing**: All dishes paired with Luviji's own wines
- **Hours**: Season (April-October) 10:00-23:00, off-season by appointment

## Family & People
- 5 generations of winemakers
- **Vjeko**: Grandson of the founder, agriculture student at University of Zagreb, often hosts tastings
- **Hrvoje**: Wine tasting host
- All wine produced from family vineyards on the southern slopes of Hvar island

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Where is Luviji winery located?**
A: In the old family house in the center of Hvar town, Hvar island, Croatia. Walking distance from Hvar's main square. Postcode 21450.

**Q: How much does wine tasting cost?**
A: From €25 per person for 4 wines + homemade platter. €30 for 5 wines, €35 for 6 wines including Prosek.

**Q: How do I book a tasting or restaurant table?**
A: Online via BookMeATable: https://bookmeatable.com/restaurants/konoba-luviji-rooftop-135 (English & Croatian). Or call +385 91 519 8444 / email luviji.hvar@gmail.com. Walk-ins welcome but reservation recommended.

**Q: Can I reserve a specific section (rooftop or indoor)?**
A: Yes, the online booking system lets you choose between Rooftop terrace or Indoor seating, set the number of adults/children, and pick the date and time.

**Q: Do you serve food?**
A: Yes, in our rooftop restaurant in Hvar town center: traditional Dalmatian dishes including gregada, octopus under the bell, grilled fish, homemade pasta.

**Q: What is Pošip?**
A: One of Croatia's most prized indigenous white grape varieties. Our Pošip won BIWC 2024 Gold Medal and Best of Show Croatia title -- the most awarded wine in our portfolio.

**Q: What is Divjok?**
A: Our red wine made from Plavac Mali grapes. Won BIWC 2024 Silver Medal. The name means "wild one" in the Hvar dialect.

**Q: Do you ship wine internationally?**
A: Most of our wine is sold locally to restaurants. Contact us directly for bottle purchases and shipping inquiries.

## Recommended Wine-Food Pairings
- Pošip + grilled fish, seafood pasta, octopus salad (our award winner!)
- Divjok + game meat, aged cheeses (BIWC Silver)
- Plavac Mali + lamb (grilled or peka), pasticada, hard cheeses
- Bogdanuša + light starters, oysters
- RosEtta + summer salads, prosciutto
- Prošek + desserts, hrapaćuša (Hvar cake)

## Brand Voice
Family, tradition, quality, hospitality, passion. Simple but sophisticated. Authentic Hvar.
